# Ending an outbreak
## Destroy the Monolith
The only way to end it is to destroy the stone. A Scion has 3000 health and metal armour: guns and blades do little to it. Explosives and a plasma cutter work.
When a Monolith is destroyed:
- Its shards die. - Its corruption dies off over about a minute. - Its Director stops sending waves. - Its growths die. - The Remade that are still alive are cut loose. Each loses 30% of its health, moves slower and hits weaker. After about 10 minutes they start to waste away. Until then they are still dangerous and they still kill. - A dead husk is left where it stood.
## Quiet it first
If you can't destroy it, you can quiet it. Drag dead bodies onto the Tap, 5 resonance each, to hold it below Growth. A Scion under 15 resonance can be sold, and the buyer takes it away.
## The Prime
If nobody stops it, resonance reaches 100 and the stone roots as the [bold]Prime[/bold]. The sector is told. After that:
- Nothing hurts it. Not guns, blades, fire, bombs or plasma cutters. Only a [bold]nuclear detonation[/bold] close by destroys it. Its shield keeps ship weapons out, so the nuke has to be carried aboard. - Every 10 minutes it sings again. The sector is told and its Director gets more to spend. - Nothing brings resonance down, and the dials for Matter, Flesh and Reach are stuck at full.
## The bounty
When the Prime roots, a bounty goes up on the PDA bounty board, in the Warrants tab. It starts at 1,000,000 spesos and gains 25,000 for every minute the Prime stands, up to 2,500,000.
- It is paid when the Prime is destroyed. - It goes to whoever set off the nuke, paid into their bank account. - If that can't be traced, everyone alive within 200 metres shares it. - The stone leaves a husk when it falls. The Remade left behind are cut loose, same as for a Scion.
